_about: Claude Code on the local model (demos 6.4 and 7.1). bin/claude-local and bin/run-baseline set these variables for one process only. They change no shell profile and no settings file. {model}, {context_length}, and {base_url} come from ollama.json and this file. Sources: https://docs.ollama.com/integrations/claude-code (manual setup), the variables that `ollama launch claude` sets (Ollama 0.40.16), and https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config (CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS for a model ID that Claude Code does not know).
